name: servicem8
description: ServiceM8 field-service management via ServiceM8's hosted OAuth MCP server (https://go.servicem8.com/mcp). Manage jobs, clients, staff, and job templates — search and list jobs/clients, create jobs from templates, add job notes, and list staff members. Browser OAuth, no API keys.

connection.instructions: Click Connect — you will be redirected to ServiceM8 to authorise access. Sign in with your ServiceM8 account and grant the requested permissions. No API keys or environment variables are needed.
